sentiment.rationale: The document reports strong backward-looking results (EPS up 18% YoY, net income $30.5B for FY2025) and provides explicit forward guidance: FY2026 NII (FTE) expected to grow 5% to 7% YoY, and management expects to deliver ~200 bps of operating leverage in 2026. CEO Brian Moynihan states 'we are bullish on the U.S. economy in 2026' and 'we feel confident in our ability to maintain this momentum in 2026 and beyond.' This constitutes a meaningful guidance raise and confident forward language, warranting a score above 0.15 but not above 0.5 because the guidance is not quantified for EPS or revenue beyond NII, and the document acknowledges risks including interest rate fluctuations and geopolitical instability.

summary.revenue: Total revenue, net of interest expense, of $28.4 billion for 4Q25, up 7% YoY. Full-year 2025 revenue of $113.1 billion, up 7% YoY.
summary.eps: Diluted earnings per share of $0.98 for 4Q25, up 18% YoY. Full-year 2025 diluted EPS of $3.81, up 19% YoY.
summary.guidance: Expect FY26 NII (FTE) to grow 5% to 7% YoY. Expect to deliver ~200 bps of operating leverage in 2026. Expect 1Q26 NII (FTE) up ~7% YoY. Expect FY26 effective tax rate of ~20%. Expect other income of $100MM to $300MM per quarter.
summary.margin: Efficiency ratio improved to 61% in 4Q25 from 63% in 4Q24. Return on average tangible common shareholders' equity of 14.0% in 4Q25 vs. 13.0% in 4Q24.
key_risks: Impact of U.S. and global interest rates (including potential for ongoing fluctuations in interest rates), inflation, currency exchange rates, economic conditions, trade policies and tensions, including changes in, or the imposition of, tariffs and/or trade barriers
Geopolitical instability, including military conflicts (Russia/Ukraine, Middle East) and potential expansion
Possibility that future credit losses may be higher than currently expected due to changes in economic assumptions
Adverse developments affecting the U.S. or global banking industry, including bank failures and liquidity concerns
Impact of failures or disruptions in or breaches of the Corporation's operations or information systems, including cybersecurity incidents
Risks related to the development, implementation, use and management of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning
Impact of uncertain or changing political conditions, federal government shutdowns and uncertainty regarding the federal government's debt limit
key_opportunities: Expect further economic growth in the year ahead, with consumers and businesses proving resilient
Regulatory environment and tax and trade policies coming into sharper focus
Fixed-rate asset repricing and disciplined expense management
Strong liquidity and capital, as well as healthy asset quality, position the company to drive core growth, market share gains and improved profitability in 2026
Continued organic growth across all business segments, including record sales and trading revenue, record equities sales and trading revenue, and 21 consecutive quarters of average loan growth
